title: Output a positive rational full-domain gap bound for every rank<=1 complex-balanced class
statement: For an infinite compiled class pin h(A)=0. Factorial tail ratio<=1/2 gives sum_tail w|h|^2<=6sum_i w_i|h_(i+1)-h_i|^2. Telescope each g-step through its length-L word; fixed-position translation is injective into one original labelled energy family, so C_tail=6L sum_j beta_j^-1 bounds the tail by C_tail D. Lift each finite-prefix path to the tail and back to A, erase loops and sum exact weighted path resistances into C_prefix. Pointwise Cauchy and Tonelli yield Var_pi(f)<=(C_tail+C_prefix)E(f,f) on the FULL form domain; output ell=1/(C_tail+C_prefix)>0 without Z. Finite classes use finite rational spanning-tree paths; singleton ell=1 is vacuous. All primitive/gcd/word/static-enabling/powers/cutoff/graph/path/population-factorial/conductance operations are finite. The source computed H includes2^B,A,L,offsets,jump coefficients,line-base/direction data and rational heights; finite-interval branches use absolute parameter endpoints and zero unused word data. Graph/path/population bounds O(H^3) and schoolbook arithmetic admit the explicit loose2^(H^20) BIT/description bound. This is a complete restricted positive algorithm for arbitrary species/arity/linkages at rank<=1, not a higher-rank classifier, independent audit or polynomial/practical bound.
